name: convert3d
description: Convert 3D and CAD files right in the chat: STEP, SKP, DWG, FBX, GLB, STL, OBJ, USDZ and 70+ more.

interface.longDescription: Attach a 3D or CAD model and ask for the format you need: convert3d converts SketchUp, DWG, STEP, FBX, USDZ, Blender, SolidWorks and 70+ other formats to STL, GLB, STEP, FBX, USDZ, OBJ, 3MF and more, with a 3D preview of the result. The conversion runs in your browser.
defaultPrompt: Convert this model to STL for 3D printing
Convert this STEP file to GLB
Which file format should I use for 3D printing?
